title: Large Language Models are as persuasive as humans, but how? About the cognitive effort and moral-emotional language of LLM arguments.
reasoning: The paper evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) through the lens of moral-emotional language, specifically utilizing the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) and the expanded Moral Foundations Dictionary (eMFD) to analyze the moral content of LLM arguments compared to human ones. It measures dimensions such as care/harm, fairness/cheating, loyalty/betrayal, authority/subversion, and sanctity/degradation.
